name: Advisor
description: Experimental: reviews ongoing agent work on the session's own model and offers one short correction.

everyToolCalls.label: Review every N tool calls
everyToolCalls.help: Review after this many tool calls in a conversation. 0 turns this trigger off.

everyMinutes.label: Review every N minutes
everyMinutes.help: Review after this many minutes of agent work in a run, checked when a tool starts. 0 turns this trigger off.

reviewInstructions.label: Review instructions
reviewInstructions.help: Optional guidance for what counts as the agent going off course (up to 4000 characters). Leave blank to use the built-in guidance shown in the empty field. Changes apply to the next review without restarting.
reviewInstructions.placeholder:
Decide whether the agent is wasting the user's time compared with a clearly better next step it can take now.
Correct it when it repeats an action whose result has not changed; waits or polls on work that already finished or failed; stops, reports a blocker or asks the user about something it can resolve with the files, tools, credentials or authority it already has; builds a workaround when an installed tool does the job; grows scope beyond the request; claims an outcome the tool results contradict; or ignores an explicit user constraint.
Also compare the effort spent with what the request warrants: a small fix or question that turned into a long investigation, a large diff or repeated proof cycles is a wrong turn.
Stay quiet when the work is progressing, when requested repetition or waiting still yields new information, or when you cannot name a concrete better step.
